subject: GPNR status: repro converging, reflective assets weak
body:
Hi Alina,

Status. The CUDA rebuild is behind us — we are on current JAX after fixing two API breaks the 0.2.19 pin was hiding. Training repro on the IBRNet scenes is converging: PSNR on held-out scenes is within 0.3dB of the paper at 80% of the training schedule, and dataset.ff_base_dir now points at our internal store instead of the drive downloads.

Quality read: on catalog-like scenes (textured objects, controlled lighting), generalization is genuinely good with no per-scene tuning. Reflective assets are the weak spot — noticeable artifacts on glass and chrome.

Risk: eval renders are slow, about 11s per 756x1008 frame — fine for previews, not for anything interactive. Flagging so the Q3 framing stays honest.

Milan
